subject: Prepay schedule, ledger ops and revenue recognition runbook
messages:
From: Emily Saunders <emily.saunders@acmecorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Multi‑year prepay — split invoicing & rev rec implications

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The procurement team asked me to confirm how we should handle invoicing for the 3‑year prepay we're discussing. Two asks from finance: (1) Can Redwood issue separate invoices for each contract year (so our ledger and budget owners can treat it as annual spend)? (2) We also need a brief mapping of how Redwood plans to recognize revenue across the three years for our auditors — high level is fine (GL lines / dates / supporting doc).

If you can send a suggested invoice schedule and an example recognition mapping we can share with our accounting team, that would help speed approval.

Attachments: none on this email.

Best,
Emily Saunders
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Acme Corp

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emily Saunders <emily.saunders@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Multi‑year prepay — split invoicing & rev rec implications

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear asks. We can absolutely do separate invoices per contract year. Two quick options we typically offer:

1) Annual invoice on contract anniversary (3 invoices: Year1, Year2, Year3).
2) Front‑loaded (Year0 partial + Year1/Year2) schedule for customers that want budgeted commitments aligned to usage ramp.

For revenue recognition, Redwood will provide an appendix that maps invoiced amount to the recognized revenue schedule per ASC 606 (we'll provide service period, GL mapping suggestion, and a CSV you can drop into your ERP). I've attached a draft SOW (ACME_SOW_v2.pdf) and a recommended invoice schedule spreadsheet (InvoiceSchedule-2026-2028.xlsx).

I copied Monica and Marissa to confirm internal approvals and to scope the final runbook material for your auditors. Will loop in Finance for the accounting-level mapping.

Next step: Does Acme prefer (A) three equal annual invoices, or (B) a ramped split (50/30/20) aligned to your expected usage? If you confirm, we'll prepare the DocuSign packet and the recognition mapping.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:02:00Z
Subject: FW: Acme request — invoice split + rev rec mapping (need finance input)

Team — FYI, Acme is asking for (1) separate per‑year invoicing and (2) a short mapping for revenue recognition for auditors. They are evaluating a 3‑year prepay with a usage ramp.

Key items we need from Finance:
- Recommended invoice invoice_line items and GL mapping (one row per contract year).
- Suggested recognition schedule (service period per invoice, monthly straight line vs. usage‑based amortization) and language for the SOW appendix.
- Any constraints on issuing multiple invoices under the committed prepay (tax implications, billing run limitations).

Ben / Rishi — can you provide a 1‑page runbook + a CSV mapping by EOD Tuesday? That should be enough for Acme auditors. Marissa / Monica — I will align on the commercialization side (discounting / deal record tweaks) once finance confirms.

Thanks — Vivek

---Quoted message preserved below---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: FW: Acme request — invoice split + rev rec mapping (need finance input)

Vivek / team —

We can support separate invoices for each contract year. Proposed approach:

A) Invoicing: issue three annual invoices on the contract anniversary (we'll put Year2 & Year3 on scheduled auto‑invoices tied to the master agreement). Our billing system will accept multiple invoice capture for a single SOW (no change to tax treatment). Attach: InvoiceSchedule-2026-2028.xlsx (tab: Billing Plan).

B) Revenue recognition: default is straight‑line over the service period for prepaid subscriptions unless the customer requests usage‑based recognition and provides clear usage metrics. For Acme's ramp scenario, recommend: recognize revenue monthly over each 12‑month service year tied to that year's invoice (i.e., Year1 invoice -> recognize months M1‑M12; Year2 invoice -> months M13‑M24, etc.). We've prepared a sample mapping CSV (Recognition-mapping.csv) showing GL account suggestions and journal entry examples.

C) Edge cases: if Acme requests an amortization that doesn't match invoice timing (e.g., wants to expense entire prepay in Year1), we need a written accounting waiver and acknowledgement from their auditors; otherwise we follow ASC 606 guidance.

I'll prep a 1‑page runbook and the CSV and drop them in the shared Drive link Vivek included. Ping me if you need a finance lead on the call with Acme.

Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Emily Saunders <emily.saunders@acmecorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Corp Finance <finance@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T16:09:00Z
Subject: Re: Prepay schedule, ledger ops and revenue recognition runbook

Thanks Vivek / Ben — this is helpful. Acme prefers option (A) three equal annual invoices — keeps our budget owners happy. Two quick clarifications: (1) For the auditors, can you confirm the GL suggestion and the recognition CSV will show which months map to which invoice? (2) We need the DocuSign SOW with the 3‑invoice payment terms so procurement can route it to legal.

If you can send the final SOW and the recognition CSV, we can route it this week.

Thanks,
Emily

Attachment: none (will accept DocuSign).

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emily Saunders <emily.saunders@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Prepay schedule, ledger ops and revenue recognition runbook

Emily — great, thanks for confirming Option A (three equal annual invoices).

Action items (we will deliver by EOD tomorrow):
- Final SOW with payment terms and schedule (DocuSign envelope). Attachment stub: ACME_SOW_v2.pdf (finalized for signature).
- InvoiceSchedule-2026-2028.xlsx (tab: Final Billing Plan) — will be used to generate the three annual invoices.
- Recognition-mapping.csv — shows GL mapping and month‑by‑month recognition allocation per invoice.

Ben confirmed straight‑line recognition tied to each invoice year; if your auditors want a different amortization we can document the request and follow up. I'll send the DocuSign link and drop the CSV in the Drive folder below once the SOW is uploaded.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: ACME_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF stub), InvoiceSchedule-2026-2028.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), Recognition-mapping.csv (CSV stub)
